mechanism: Nifedipine may inhibit CYP3A4-mediated metabolism of primaquine, potentially increasing primaquine levels and hemolytic risk, while primaquine's oxidative metabolites may theoretically affect nifedipine metabolism.
action: Monitor for signs of hemolysis (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue) and nifedipine efficacy; consider alternative antimalarial if G6PD deficiency present; baseline CBC recommended.
